answerable.question: How many customers are there?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer;

answerable.question: List the names of all genres.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre;

answerable.question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000;

answerable.question: Give the first name, last name and email of customers from Brazil.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

answerable.question: How many albums are there?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album;

answerable.question: Which employees have the title Sales Support Agent? Show first and last name.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';

answerable.question: How many invoices have a total greater than 10?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 10;

answerable.question: How many customers have an email address ending in gmail.com?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Email LIKE '%@gmail.com';

answerable.question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice;

answerable.question: What is the average track length in seconds?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track;

answerable.question: How many tracks are there in each genre? Show genre name and count.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name;

answerable.question: What are the top 5 billing countries by total invoice amount? Show country and total.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 5;

answerable.question: How many invoices were issued in each year? Show year and count.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), COUNT(*) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1;

answerable.question: Which country has the most customers?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: What is the highest unit price among tracks?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track;

answerable.question: How many distinct composers are listed in the Track table?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Composer) FROM Track;

answerable.question: What was the total invoice revenue in 2023?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023';

answerable.question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';

answerable.question: How many tracks does the artist Iron Maiden have?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden';

answerable.question: Which 3 artists have the most tracks? Show artist name and track count.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3;

answerable.question: How many distinct customers have purchased at least one Jazz track?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz';

answerable.question: What is the first and last name of the employee who supports the customer with email luisg@embraer.com.br?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE c.Email = 'luisg@embraer.com.br';

answerable.question: Which playlists contain the track 'Fast As a Shark'? Show playlist names.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE t.Name = 'Fast As a Shark';

answerable.question: What are the top 3 genres by sales revenue (unit price times quantity)? Show genre name and revenue.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 3;

answerable.question: Which media type has the most tracks? Show the media type name.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT m.Name FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: Which employee (first and last name) supports the most customers?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent? Show first name, last name and total spent.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 3;

answerable.question: How many tracks are longer than the average track length?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track);

answerable.question: How many artists have no albums?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album);

answerable.question: List the titles of albums that have more than 20 tracks.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

answerable.question: How many customers have spent more than the average customer's total spending?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) WHERE s > (SELECT AVG(s2) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s2 FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId));

answerable.question: Which genre has the highest average track length? Show the genre name.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY AVG(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: How many employees report to Nancy Edwards?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo = (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Nancy' AND LastName = 'Edwards');

answerable.question: List the first and last names of customers from Canada who spent more than 38 in total.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Canada' GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 38;

answerable.question: What is the name of the longest track?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: Which employee was hired first? Show first and last name.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee ORDER BY HireDate LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: How many customers are in the state CA?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE State = 'CA';

answerable.question: How many customers are from the United States?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA';

answerable.question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock';

answerable.question: What is the total amount billed to the United Kingdom?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'United Kingdom';

answerable.question: How many tracks are in the playlist called Heavy Metal Classic?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Heavy Metal Classic';
